title: Sigurnost CI/CD platforme
summary: Rizici CI/CD platforme po OWASP Top 10 CI/CD, poisoned pipeline execution i izolacija runnera, te identitet pipelinea: GitLab id_tokens prema AWS-u i Vaultu, zaštićene grane, varijable i okruženja i najmanje privilegije po jobu.
summary_en: CI/CD platform risks per the OWASP Top 10 CI/CD, poisoned pipeline execution and runner isolation, and pipeline identity: GitLab id_tokens to AWS and Vault, protected branches, variables and environments, and least privilege per job.
